policy: One explicit actionable card issue maps to its category. Multiple issues, unresolved contradictions and missing context require clarification. Other services are outside this desk.

cases.text: A thief ran off with my bag containing my credit card. I need to report the card theft.
cant locate my debti card anywere want to report it lost
The card is not damaged and I recognize all the payments. The problem is that my bank card has vanished.
Since leaving the taxi yesterday I have not been able to find my bank card. Please report it as missing.
My credit card statement lists a purchase in another country that I never made.
someone used my bank card for a purchse withot my aproval
I know where my card is and the plastic is fine. There is an unauthorized charge I need investigated.
Please investigate a card transaction billed yesterday; I did not give anyone permission for that payment.
My payment card went through the washing machine and the plastic split apart.
the chip on my credit card is physicly damagd
This is not about a declined purchase. My debit card's plastic has broken and needs attention.
My bank card bent in my pocket, and now a crack runs right across the chip.
The card terminal refused my payment for petrol even though I have sufficient balance.
my debti card was declned when paying for lunch
I do not need a new card or a PIN update. My current bank card purchase keeps getting rejected.
Can you help with a credit card payment that the online store would not accept?
I would like to select a different four-digit code for my debit card PIN.
help me chnge the pin numbr for my bank card
I remember my current card PIN perfectly. I want to replace it with another number.
Please walk me through updating the PIN used with my credit card.
A replacement debit card was dispatched for me. How soon should it arrive by mail?
when shoud the replacment bank card reach my adress
I already requested the replacement and do not need to order another. How long until that card arrives?
I need the estimated date for delivery of my replacement credit card.
My digital camera cannot read its damaged storage card. Recommend a new SD card.
Help me change the PIN used to unlock the SIM in my smartphone.
How long will the replacement keyboard I ordered take to arrive?
I want to raise the limit on my debit card transactions.
My bank card is causing trouble. I do not have any other information.
My card was taken, and I also need to report an unauthorized charge made on it.
My debit card is bent and cracked, and separately I need a new PIN for a different card.
The card may be missing or it may be in my bag. I cannot tell what the actual problem is.
